questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence with reported speech.
He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he was finishing his homework.
He said he would have finished his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement?
She said, 'I am not sure if I will come to the party.'
options: She said she wasn't sure whether she would come to the party.
She said she wasn't sure if she will come to the party.
She said she wasn't sure whether she would come to the party.
She said she wasn't sure if she would come to the party.
questions.answer: She said she wasn't sure whether she would come to the party.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported form.
He said to me, 'Don't forget to call me tomorrow.'
options: He told me not to forget to call him the next day.
He told me to forget to call him tomorrow.
He said to me not to forget to call him tomorrow.
He said to me don't forget to call him tomorrow.
questions.answer: He told me not to forget to call him the next day.

questions.question:
Which option correctly reports the negative command?
She said, 'Don't make so much noise!'
options: She told him not to make so much noise.
She said not to make so much noise.
She said to him don't make so much noise.
She said not making so much noise.
questions.answer: She said not to make so much noise.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported speech.
He said, 'I've never seen such a beautiful sunset before.'
options: He said he had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
He said he has never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
He said he never saw such a beautiful sunset before.
He said he never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
questions.answer: He said he had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported form.
They said, 'We have been waiting for you for an hour.'
options: They said they had been waiting for an hour.
They said they were waiting for an hour.
They said they had been waiting for you for an hour.
They said they had been waiting for you an hour.
questions.answer: They said they had been waiting for you for an hour.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the conditional statement?
He said, 'If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.'
options: He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would have attended it.
He said that if he knew about the meeting, he would have attended it.
He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would attend it.
He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would attend.
questions.answer: He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would have attended it.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported form of the third conditional.
She said, 'If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.'
options: She said that if she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
She said that if she had studied harder, she would pass the exam.
She said that if she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
She said that if she had studied harder, she passed the exam.
questions.answer: She said that if she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported speech.
He said, 'I'm sure that he will win the competition.'
options: He said he was sure that he would win the competition.
He said he was sure that he will win the competition.
He said he was sure that he is going to win the competition.
He said he was sure that he would have won the competition.
questions.answer: He said he was sure that he would win the competition.

questions.question:
Which option correctly reports the imperative sentence?
They said, 'Let's go to the cinema tonight!'
options: They said to go to the cinema that night.
They said let's go to the cinema tonight.
They said to us let's go to the cinema that night.
They said let's go to the cinema that night.
questions.answer: They said let's go to the cinema that night.
